text:
Maya (PM): uploaded a quick mock of the regression run page — heatmap + per-sample sparklines + a right-hand context panel. PTAL for layout and a11y. link: https://figma.com/xxx Ravi (Design): nice — I like the mini-sparklines in the table row for trend at-a-glance. question: do we need a hover to expand values? :eyes: Joe (Eng): sparklines are fine but rendering 10k rows with svg sparklines will kill the client. we should virtualize and render canvas thumbnails or precompute small bitmaps on the server. Aisha (QA): noticed with VoiceOver that when you move focus to the first row the context panel steals focus unexpectedly. need to ensure focus isn't trapped and keyboard nav remains row -> actions -> context panel optional. Sam (Accessibility): agree with Aisha. Also we should provide a summary for the whole run (total regressions, top 3 flakies) as a skip-link target and an aria-live region for regression counts so screen readers get an immediate overview. Maya (PM): microcopy thought: change primary approval CTA from "Approve run" to "Approve results" — less ambiguous when users are looking at diffs. also consider a disabled tooltip when no selections. Ravi (Design): +1 on microcopy. For the context panel proposed layout: header with sample id + small actions, then stacked sections (recent history sparkline, example input/output, related prompts). We can collapse history to a single sparklines row. For a11y: add "Show more" buttons with aria-expanded. Joe (Eng): implementation note: for aria-live we can use a polite live region that updates on run load. sample snippet works — ```
Run: 12 regressions, 3 flakies
``` For sparklines, create a fallback and only mount full svg on focus/hover to save cycles. Aisha (QA): another nit: keyboard quick-approve shortcut. currently cmd+enter triggers modal but modal focus order breaks when context panel is open. proposal: quick-approve should target selected items only and if the context panel is open, pressing q (or another key) should close panel first. Sam (Accessibility): suggestion: add an offscreen label for each sparkline like "last 30 runs: mostly stable, 2 dips" so screen readers have context. Do not rely solely on color or tiny icons. Ravi (Design): visual idea — add a tiny delta chip next to the sparkline (▲/▼ + percent) with color + textual label (e.g., "+4% regressions"). make sure contrast meets 4.5:1 for non-icon text. Joe (Eng): will prototype virtualization + canvas + aria-live. FYI this adds an optional server-side precompute but toggled per-customer. estimate: 2 dev days + 1 QA day. Maya (PM): awesome, thanks. next steps: Joe to prototype, Ravi to iterate mock with collapsed history and aria-expanded states, Sam/Aisha to write acceptance criteria for SR and keyboard flows. I'll book a 30-min sync tomorrow. cc @ux-bot for checklist :thumbsup: ux-bot: checklist created: [Design mock updated], [ARIA acceptance criteria], [Prototype branch], [QA tests]. Maya (PM): merging notes — keep the approval CTA change and the summary live region. let's avoid adding too many toggles in the first iteration. schedule sync at 10:30am PT? Ravi (Design): 10:30 works for me. will push an updated Figma with collapsed history + delta chips before the sync. Joe (Eng): noted. I'll put a draft PR with canvas fallback and an example aria-live implementation for review before the meeting. Aisha (QA): I'll draft the acceptance tests, including screen reader walkthroughs and keyboard-only flows. Sam (Accessibility): I'll review the acceptance tests and add suggested SR copy for sparklines and the run summary. Maya (PM): perfect — thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
